notes: Compiled 2026-10-17 from public web sources only; nobody was contacted. Every email or form above is as shown on the outlet's or gym's own site unless the entry says otherwise (the OAWA provincial club listing and the Let's Roll gym directory are the exceptions, and are flagged). Six media entries are marked 'low' because the outlet's site blocked automated access: Peterborough Examiner, Belleville Intelligencer, Kingston Whig-Standard, DurhamRegion.com, Durham Radio News, and Cageside Press (no public email). MEDIA PRIORITIES: The Highlander (news@thehighlander.ca) and Bancroft This Week (michael@haliburtonpress.com) have both already covered CCCL. kawarthaNOW (editor@kawarthanow.com plus free event listings) reaches Peterborough, Kawartha Lakes, Haliburton and Hastings. The Moose FM sites (Bancroft and Haliburton) and PTBOToday have simple tip and event forms. Quinte News (timdurkin@cjbq.com) is the main desk for Marmora, Madoc and Belleville. Global News has three desks: Peterborough newswatch@chextv.com, Kingston newswatch@corusent.com, and Toronto/Durham newstips@globaltv.com. MM-Eh (andy@mm-eh.ca) is the go-to Canadian regional MMA outlet. It lists CCCL 1 as completed but has no 2027 CCCL dates, so send them. Marmora and Madoc have no dedicated local paper; Quinte News, inQuinte and kawarthaNOW (Hastings County events) cover them. Municipal calendars often exclude for-profit events or competitions (Kawartha Lakes favours not-for-profits; Durham Tourism excludes 'Competitions'), so a youth or charity angle may help. GYM PRIORITIES: Big Country MMA Lindsay is the strongest partner. It supplied several CCCL 1 fighters (main-event winner Jake Parsons, Levi Oram, and possibly Cooper Elliott) and has pros James Clarke and Blake Oswald. In Kingston, Grizzly Gym (Joshua Henshaw fought CCCL 1, BTC 34 and PFC 20) and van Jango (Jesse Van Vlack, 8 amateur MMA bouts) are proven sources of amateur MMA fighters. The Chop Shop MMA (Haliburton) is the closest gym, with ex-Hayabusa Kingston coaches. Infinite MMA (Belleville) and Limitless (Trenton) cover Quinte, and Mamute and Oshawa BJJ cover Oshawa. Evolution Jiu Jitsu Petawawa is closer than it looks on a map. Wrestling clubs from the OAWA listing (Kawartha WC, Kingston WC, Kingston Combat WC, Mariposa WC, Pinnacle WC) are a source of wrestlers moving into MMA.
